title: THE ROOM BEHIND A WINDOW HAS NO WORDS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): make the menus look like a AAA game, checked in pictures. Round a small window such as Wirt or the Last Pour, the big station signs of the Undercroft still read through the dark glass (WIRT THE GAMBLER, ENTER RAID!, a cut off SHOP, CR), like a second menu under the first. The room behind a window is now softly blurred as well as dimmed.
now: The Undercroft behind a window is blurred, so its signs no longer read through.
